about.heading: About
about.text: I am a psychologist specialising in autism therapy, currently working full-time at Behindertenhilfe in Stadt und Kreis Offenbach e.V. My focus is on individual and group therapy, counselling parents and specialist institutions, and conducting diagnostic assessments. Through my Master of Science in Business Psychology at Middlesex University, I bring both clinical and academic expertise.
